name: Dog Town
summary:
🐶 Dog Town is a social VR hangout where players explore, chill, and survive together 🎮. Run through colorful streets 🏙️, hide from monsters 👹, and team up with friends 🤝 in fast-paced, playful gameplay designed for fun and laughs 😄.

🎭 Customize your look with fresh drip from the shop 👕✨, discover different areas 🗺️, and jump into quick sessions ⏱️ that are easy to pick up but hard to put down. Dog Town is perfect for friends who want a mix of chaos 💥, exploration 🔍, and social fun 🗣️ in VR 🥽.
